title: Mae's Progression 'N' Stuff
description: Adjusts ore progression to slow down gameplay.
body:
# Overview
Adjusts the ore progression to slow gameplay down, requiring you to adventure more before upgrading your gear through the addition of upgrade templates.

# Upgrade Templates
Ore progression has been adjusted, forcing you to first obtain copper gear alongside an upgrade template to obtain iron equipment and tools, and vice versa for obtaining the diamond variants.

Upgrade Templates can be found in many different structures, the loot pools are as follows.


### ![Iron Upgrade Template](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/59a8d85aa005eecd1e1cd819e83d6414dbf09792.png) Iron Upgrade Templates:
- Jungle Temple
- Ruined Portal
- Pillager Outpost
- Shipwreck (Treasure)
- Mineshaft
- Buried Treasure
- Desert Pyramid
- Fishing (Treasure)
- Dungeon
- Trial Chambe Vaults
- Underwater Ruins
- Blacksmiths

### ![Diamond Upgrade Template](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6425df50c2208feae769109493e6a3fe481e26ef.png) Diamond Upgrade Templates:
- Ancient City
- Mineshaft
- Bastion
- Jungle Temple
- Nether Fortress
- Stronghold
- Trial Chamber Vaults
